args.body:
- Newsletter: Bellwether Office's latest issue covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to its main blog article and a companion piece tailored to the reader's organization.
- Article (blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain): Where carriers shared live sensor data, temperature excursions fell 30%, and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece (insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion): Carriers that ran pilots cut claims by a quarter (~25%).
args.title: Bellwether Office — Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 (newsletter, article, companion)
